notes.title: Build V1.0.256
notes.notes:
WOW. What a ride this has been. Thank you.

Some users have reported issues with their steam leaderboards on multiple games. This caused GO-4-Soldier-1 to hang while trying to load the leaderboard. We have added an offline feature for the handful of users that where having problems with their steam accounts. Thank you for the patience of those users with problems while we worked hard to get a workaround into their hands ASAP.

As the first game for our studio, we are very happy with the reception and response we have received and the support expressed. We have also taken your feedback, that the game was not priced right onboard and lowered the price significantly. As a new studio, it is sometimes hard to figure out what the "right" pricing model would be for our games. We do not believe in the in-game milking of players, but we still have to make a living. We hope that the lower/reduced price now hits that right balance.

Once again, thank you for your overwhelming support and encouragement.

Regards
ARMSCor Studios

notes.title: Build V1.0.248
notes.notes: After some constructive criticism from a twitch streamer, we decided to change and improve the mission selection screen. Feedback is always welcome and acted upon ASAP. You can now see your steam leaderboard score for each level, compared to the highest score for that level. We also show whether you have unlocked the achievement for that level. A handy gold crown icon shows if you are the current score leader for a particular level. Any more feedback? Please share with us and we'll see where and how we can improve. Thank you for the overwhelming support so far. It's been a rollercoaster ride so far! :)
